item.title: Mumbai Police investigate shooting targeting actor Tiger Shroff

item.title: Dhaka Police arrest six suspects and recover nine stolen motorbikes

item.title: Second day of Lalon observation festival observed in Kushtia
item.description: The second day of the three-day festival commemorating the death anniversary of mystic philosopher Fakir Lalon Shah took place yesterday in Cheuria, Kumarkhali, Kushtia, drawing numerous participants.

item.title: Four arrested over murder of auto-van driver in Joypurhat

item.title: Houthi attacks in Middle East raise economic and security concerns for Bangladesh
item.description: Recent Houthi strikes in the Middle East have disrupted regional flights and maritime routes while increasing fuel import expenses for Bangladesh. These developments pose potential risks to bilateral trade, overseas employment, and remittance inflows.

item.title: Four high-profile detainees undergo medical checks prior to remand

item.title: Salman Agha century and Eshan Malinga wickets lead Pakistan

item.title: Trump Backs Netanyahu for Upcoming Israeli Knesset Elections
